# InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management

## Abstract

InfiniGen is a KV cache management framework that improves performance and accuracy in long-text generation by pre-fetching essential KV cache entries in offloading-based LLM serving systems.

## AI Overview

When an LLM generates long text, it stores keys and values from earlier tokens so it need not recompute them. This store is the KV cache, and it grows with sequence length and batch size. Offloading the cache from GPU to larger CPU memory helps fit the workload. However, fetching it back over the CPU–GPU connection can become a major inference cost.

This reduces the computational complexity of inference from quadratic to linear, significantly accelerating the process.

## 2. Why is KV Cache important for TransformerArchitecture? [...] In LLM, KV Cache has become a key mechanism for the efficient operation of the Transformer architecture. It not only solves the computational redundancy problem caused by long contexts but also directly contributes to latency control and throughput improvement. Its importance is primarily reflected in the following aspects: [...] Reduced computational overhead:Avoiding repeated attention calculations on historical sequences reduces inference complexity from quadratic to approximately linear.
   Improved inference speed:Significantly reduces latency when generating long texts, improving the user experience.
   Enhanced resource utilization:Reduces unnecessary GPU memory and computing power consumption, providing space for memory optimization.
